description: Single storey extension above the existing side extension with addition of garage door at ground floor, replacement of existing windows with double glazed timber sash windows, addition a small window under entrance to stairs to serve WC and associated works.
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">CONDITION: No development, including demolition, site clearance, and preparatory works, shall commence until a finalised RIBA Stage 4 BS5837:2012 compliant Arboricultural Method Statement (AMS) and Tree Protection Plan (TPP) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The AMS must specifically address the demolition approach to keep the risk of harm to retained adjacent trees as low as practicably possible, and specify temporary ground protection dependent upon anticipated loading. The development shall thereafter be carried out strictly in accordance with the approved details. REASON: To safeguard existing retained trees in line with BS5837(2012), in the interests of visual amenity in accordance with Policy LP51 of Hackney Local Plan 2033.</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Part 1) Prior to the commencement of development, a qualified tree specialist must be appointed to provide arboricultural supervision and inspection. The details of this appointment and the specialist's responsibilities must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The submission should include the methodology and programme for reporting, as well as a timetable for inspections. The approved works must be carried out in strict accordance with the approved details. Part 2) Upon completion of the development, a report from the appointed arboriculturist must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, confirming that all tree protection measures and tree works were carried out in accordance with the approved plans accompanied by photographs taken at critical stages. REASON: to ensure that works affecting trees are carried out in a professional and controlled manner, safeguarding their health and long-term viability. This is in accordance with good arboricultural practice and is supported by BS 5837:2012 and Policy LP51 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033.</span></p>
